snippet.title: Galaxy on Fire 2 HD incl. Valkyrie and Supernova for ANDROID by FISHLABS - Official Trailer
snippet.description: Galaxy on Fire 2 HD finally blazes onto Google Play in a platform-optimized "All Android" version, including Valkyrie and Supernova and supporting over 200 Android-powered smartphones and tablets!
